requirements: Claim this canonical job after reading assignment and current board. Verify the exact remote fork head and contributor PR head/ancestry and refresh discussion. Reconcile prior real-zk job release plus evidence of stopped executor and any host conflicts; do not infer stoppage from a release alone. If source or PR head moves, reconcile before proceeding and supersede as necessary.

Review new ConnectionManagerRealZkRecoveryTest for race control, normal ZooKeeper watcher dispatch, proper latch and proxy cleanup, process leaks, assumptions and maintainability, including whether the logging appender can confuse events from different sessions or its hold timeout could let the test pass without establishing the intended ordering. The change intentionally avoids global production observer hooks. Inspect the production wait and ensure only the replacement keeper controls its terminal retry. Report any concern separately; do not classify an unobserved event ordering as proof.

Pristine head: run ./gradlew tidy, git diff --check and require no tracked changes. Run ./gradlew :solr:core:validateSourcePatterns and ./gradlew logchangeGenerate; check both SOLR-18623 changelog entries. A formatting or source repair changes the head, so publish a scoped fix and superseding exact-head gate before claiming completion; do not silently use an altered head.

Run ./gradlew :solr:core:cleanTest :solr:core:test --tests org.apache.solr.cloud.ConnectionManagerRealZkRecoveryTest.testExpiredReplacementDoesNotBlockRecovery -Ptests.seed=5301C0DE --rerun-tasks. Require one actual executed test with zero failures/errors/skips; run three independent invocations with separate logs/XML to expose timing instability. Record actual runtime, bounded-event and cleanup behavior and inspect session/connect/disconnect/expiry evidence. Retain logs and XML before each cleanTest.

Fail-before proof: in an isolated checkout at the same head retain the exact same new test and all other files; replace only solr/solrj-zookeeper/src/java/org/apache/solr/common/cloud/ConnectionManager.java with its exact parent de36597d blob 5f094c80f1e23e1695a6a5839df038eac5d63558. Run the identical focused test/seed. Require one executed runtime failure specifically at 'connection manager did not recover' after B's real connected callback was held, B's real disconnected callback applied, B terminal expiry delivered, stale callback rejected, and the server remained reachable. A timeout, compilation/fixture failure, unrelated listener failure, skipped test or lack of ordering is not fail-before. Save diff, source hashes, full fresh JUnit XML/log and event evidence. Examine how observable the sequence is without diagnostic hooks; use separate non-invasive diagnostic traces if needed and disclose any hooks/limitations, keeping the compared test identical.

Run ./gradlew :solr:core:cleanTest :solr:core:test --tests org.apache.solr.cloud.ConnectionManagerTest --tests org.apache.solr.cloud.TestConnectionManagerReconnectStress -Ptests.nightly=true -Ptests.seed=5301C0DE --rerun-tasks. Record executed counts, existing ignored tests and all failures. Run ./gradlew :solr:solrj-zookeeper:cleanTest :solr:solrj-zookeeper:test --tests org.apache.solr.common.cloud.SolrZkClientTest -Ptests.seed=5301C0DE --rerun-tasks. Do not present skips as passes.

Run ./gradlew check -x test and Error Prone compilation using :solr:solrj-zookeeper:compileJava :solr:core:compileTestJava -Pvalidation.errorprone=true -Pjavac.failOnWarnings=false. Report any baseline warning and whether it matches the previously documented FloatRangeFieldTest.java:328 precision warning; warning-tolerant compilation is not a warning-free result. Diagnose all failures before retrying; retain attempts, logs, environment and exit codes.

Publish exact-head receipt and report, including all proof legs, hashes, logs, JUnit, reproduction schedule and review findings. A complete green result requires all named legs and no unresolved patch, proof or test-maintenance concern; otherwise identify exact outstanding work. No public comment, PR body edit, contributor-branch change or upstream push is authorized by this job. Publish evidence and executor-stop proof before release.
